questions.question: What does @ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "clinic") do?
options: Binds every setting that starts with clinic to fields of the class
Creates a database table called clinic
Reads only the single key named clinic
Turns the class into a REST controller
questions.explanation: It binds the group of settings under one prefix to a class or record and converts the values to the field types.

questions.question: Which annotation on the main class registers all @ConfigurationProperties records found in the project?
questions.explanation: @ConfigurationPropertiesScan finds properties types and registers them as beans; @EnableConfigurationProperties lists them by hand.

questions.question: application.yml has 'clinic: slot-length: 15m'. The record field is Duration slotLength. What does slotLength().toMinutes() return?
options: It fails because 15m is not a number
questions.explanation: Spring converts the 15m text to a Duration of fifteen minutes, so toMinutes() returns 15.

questions.question: The file has clinic.max-daily-tokens=60 and the record has int maxDailyTokens. What value does the record hold?
options: 60, because relaxed binding matches the two names
The app fails to start because of the hyphens
questions.explanation: Relaxed binding maps the kebab-case key max-daily-tokens to the camel-case field maxDailyTokens.

questions.question: A record has @Validated and @Max(200) on maxDailyTokens, yet a value of 500 starts the app without any error. What is the most likely cause?
options: The validation starter is missing from the pom.xml
The value must be written in quotes
questions.explanation: Without spring-boot-starter-validation there is no validator on the classpath, so the constraints are not checked.
